items.title: Path of Exile 2 Wants to Join Steam’s 1 Million Player Club With Version 1.0, As Grinding Gear Games Eyes Elden Ring and Cyberpunk 2077’s Records
items.summary: Path of Exile 2 director Jonathan Rogers aims to surpass 1 million Steam players when the free-to-play 1.0 launch hits
items.content:
While The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake and Grand Theft Auto VI are monopolizing the attention of the entire video game industry, there are a few more highly anticipated games launching next month on PC , PlayStation 5 , Xbox Series X , and Xbox Series S . Chief among them is the official launch of Path of Exile 2 1.0 on December 11 , after two years in Early Access , a release that will mark the game's jump to a free-to-play model. Developer Grinding Gear Games' expectations for this launch are high, as they aim to reach a number of players on Steam that only eight games have to date.

"Our goal is to further expand the new player base through the 1.0 official launch and free-to-play transition. We have high expectations internally, especially since we heard that many existing 'Path of Exile' players are also eagerly awaiting the full launch of Path of Exile 2," said director Jonathan Rogers during a joint media interview in Busan, as reported by Inven Global . "To share a specific goal, we would love to surpass 1 million players on Steam. Of course, we also expect a significant number of players on other platforms. Considering Korean players as well, we believe even more people will enjoy the game."

Although it's not yet clear if Rogers meant concurrent players or total players, there's no denying that Path of Exile 2 has the potential to hit the 1 million concurrent players target on Steam , which is the hardest metric to hit, as it already hit 578,569 concurrent players on Steam on December 8, 2024, two days after its paid Early Access launch. With a free-to-play release, and many original Path of Exile players expected to make the jump, the game's concurrent players number is likely to be higher than the over half-a-million number of the Early Access release. For reference, only 8 games managed to do so so far, with two other major titles getting very close:

Alongside discussing the studio's player target, the Path of Exile 2 director addressed one of the community's biggest pain points: the length of the campaign and being forced to repeat it to level up alternate characters, among other things. While no campaign skip will be provided, new features will be introduced to alleviate the issues and enable speedier progress.

"The campaign focuses on enabling first-time players to fully experience the story and world while becoming immersed. Therefore, when playing through the campaign for the first time, we prepared it to preserve the classic story experience and the thrill of adventure," Rogers said. "However, we know that returning players or those replaying the campaign in a new league can feel fatigue from repeated play. To address this, we previously introduced features that more clearly guide players toward the next area or path. This improvement ensures that players repeating the campaign don't waste time finding their way and can progress faster. The previous Interlude content was temporarily prepared, so it fell short of the quality level the team aimed for. In contrast, the newly added Act 5 is official content built around a fresh storyline. We expect players to experience significantly higher quality and enjoyment compared to the previous Interlude."

Having only played Path of Exile 2 during gamescom 2024 and in its earliest Early Access incarnation , I am really looking forward to seeing how the entire experience has been overhauled for its official 1.0 launch. If the developer builds on the great qualities the game showed right from launch and keeps the momentum going by listening to community feedback, there's a high chance they will indeed reach that coveted player target.

items.title: GTA 6 bugs draw comparisons to Cyberpunk 2077's messy launch, but it's far from the same thing
items.summary: GTA 6 players have been encountering different bugs and glitches, and some are now comparing the launch to Cyberpunk 2077.
items.content:
PC Guide is reader-supported. When you buy through links on our site, we may earn an affiliate commission. Read More Table of Contents Latest tech deals. GTA 6 glitches spotted so far GTA 6 is finally here after more than a decade of waiting, and millions of players are getting their first taste of Rockstar Games’ massive open world. While the game has received excellent reviews, with an impressive record-tying score of 99 on Metacritic, some players have already started reporting bugs and glitches. A few of these issues have even led to comparisons with Cyberpunk 2077 , which had one of the most controversial launches in gaming history, and then one of the best redemptions.

🔥 More offers: see our Black Friday GTA 6 deals 2026 guide, updated daily, or browse all Black Friday deals .

However, it’s important to understand that GTA 6 is nowhere near as broken as Cyberpunk 2077 was when it first launched. The game has only just been released, and while there are some technical issues, the early reports don’t suggest that they are affecting the majority of players.

One of the clips getting attention comes from streamer Michael Does Life, who shared footage of a strange encounter with a police officer. During the fight, the characters appear to overlap with each other and even pass through nearby furniture. The streamer criticized the glitch and compared the situation to Cyberpunk 2077’s launch. Others show the player clipping out of the map.

GTA 6 is LITERALLY UNPLAYABLE because of this bug 😡 📽️ u/MyGothicAllure pic.twitter.com/mDjgTbNngp

Other players have also encountered unusual problems. For instance, streamer JasonTheWeen captured a large boat behaving strangely near a bridge, while another video shows Lucia apparently falling through the ground during a mission. There have also been reports of characters passing through objects and unexpected animations during police encounters.

JasonTheWeen discovers the first bug in GTA VI “I'm getting glitches and bugs already.. 13 years in the making” pic.twitter.com/d5Y4lglea8

Naturally, these clips have attracted plenty of attention on social media, especially considering how long Rockstar spent developing GTA 6. Some players expected the game to be nearly flawless at launch, while others have pointed out that occasional bugs are common in large open-world games. But comparing the situation to Cyberpunk 2077’s launch might be going too far.

When Cyberpunk 2077 arrived in December 2020, it suffered from widespread technical problems, particularly on older consoles. There’s a reason why GTA 6 isn’t on PS4 and Xbox One. Players reported serious performance issues, crashes, and numerous bugs that made the game difficult to enjoy. The situation became so bad that Sony temporarily removed Cyberpunk 2077 from the PlayStation Store and offered full refunds.

GTA 6, on the other hand, appears to be in a much better position. Although players have discovered glitches, the game has received overwhelmingly positive reviews, with critics praising its visuals, world design, and overall experience. There have been some performance concerns as well, particularly on the base PS5 , but the available evidence doesn’t suggest a launch disaster comparable to Cyberpunk 2077. Any full-on game crashes will likely remain the biggest concern for Rockstar with patches moving forward.

As a PC gamer, are you interested in upcoming consoles? Especially considering PC hardware prices?

I'll stick to gaming on PC for the foreseeable future

Sign in to your ScreenRant account Summary Generate a summary of this story Like Like follow Follow followed Followed Listen Thread Log in Here is a fact-based summary of the story contents: Try something different: Show me the facts Explain it like I’m 5 Give me a lighthearted recap Cyberpunk 2077 is forever expanding with new and exciting content. CD Projekt Red seemingly can't let it rest, with new updates releasing at a surprisingly consistent pace, introducing not only bug fixes and tweaks but entire new features in Cyberpunk 2077 that give fans a reason to return to Night City for the umpteenth time. Of course, this is undeniably for the best, as there is always more room for growth, especially in an open-world as richly detailed as Night City.

Adding to this pantheon of great Cyberpunk 2077 updates is a brand-new expansion that completely integrates much of The Witcher 3's stunning world into the game. For fans who've always wanted to see The Witcher 3's expansive cities and landscapes in first-person, Beyond Worlds absolutely caters to that and more. It's an impressive addition to an already enormous game, and one that fans of CD Projekt Red's work will undeniably appreciate.

Cyberpunk 2077: Beyond Worlds is a brand-new mod created by CHATDOO. While not the most ambitious Cyberpunk 2077 mod ever made, it does come pretty close, as it adds entire sections of The Witcher 3's map into the game as their own unique locations. Players can explore Velen and Novigrad as one seamless open world within Cyberpunk 2077's engine, complete with the first-person view. Over 300,000 unique buildings, props, and items have been placed to recreate these spaces, making for an exact replica of The Witcher 3's bustling city streets and dense forests.

Beyond Worlds 0.2 update also introduces NPCs to Novigrad specifically, adding 840 residents to the city. They have their own unique routes powered by a navigation mesh, with guards patrolling walls, vendors standing near their stalls, and general townsfolk milling about. Many of them also stick to daily routines, coming out during the day and disappearing at night, and vice versa. This will likely expand to other regions of the map as the mod's development progresses.

To introduce players to this new region, Cyberpunk 2077: Beyond Worlds features a brief prologue quest. Once completed, players are then transported to the Continent, where they can roam freely. It has a day-and-night cycle, with torches and other light sources illuminating Novigrad and Velen, as well as full ground and building collision. Of course, being in its Alpha state, the mod is missing features like enterable buildings, animals, additional NPCs, and further quests, but these could be added in the future.

If you're interested in playing the Cyberpunk 2077: Beyond Worlds mod, you can download it from its official NexusMods page . You will need the Cyber Engine Tweaks , RED4ext , Codeware , ArchiveXL , Extended World Framework , and Story Maker mods for it to work, in addition to Living World Framework and TweakXL if you want NPCs in Novigrad.

However, to be able to see The Witcher 3's most iconic landmarks up close and personal within Cyberpunk 2077 is worth the hassle of downloading all of these mods. It's a fun addition to an already enormous game, and certainly opens up the potential for even more Cyberpunk 2077 crossovers like it.

Cyberpunk 2077 game cover Add ScreenRant on Google Add as Preferred Source Follow on Google Discover By Tom Wilson Published Nov 16, 2026, 6:32 AM EST Tom Wilson is a Gaming Features Writer at Screen Rant. Over the past five years, Tom has worked as the Editor-in-Chief at The Game Crater, as a Staff Writer for GamingIntel, a List Writer at TheGamer, and, of course, as a Senior Writer at ScreenRant. Tom has experience writing reviews, guides, news, and features, and has been responsible for teams of writers, training them and editing their work. Tom graduated with a Masters in Multimedia Journalism, and has since gone on to build up his portfolio of games journalism work. Sign in to your ScreenRant account Summary Generate a summary of this story Like Like follow Follow followed Followed Listen Thread Log in Here is a fact-based summary of the story contents: Try something different: Show me the facts Explain it like I’m 5 Give me a lighthearted recap Cyberpunk 2077 is the game that keeps on growing. CD Projekt Red, six years after the base game dropped, has released numerous updates of varying significance, as well as the critically acclaimed expansion and assorted expanded media releases. There is simply no shortage of ways to interact with Night City and the wider Cyberpunk world, unless you want to do so with a friend, of course. Cyberpunk 2077's official multiplayer was canceled back in 2021, with CD Projekt Red stating there are no plans to implement it in the future.

Naturally, this proved to be a huge blow to the game's fanbase, who had dreamed of roaming through Night City with their friends. However, it also proved to be a challenge for modders, who have since set about implementing what CD Projekt Red lacked the resources and time for. We've gotten announcements of a Far Cry -esque Cyberpunk 2077 co-op mod that makes the entire game's story playable with a friend, as well as a full-blown multiplayer experience which has finally gone live.

CyberMP is a mod that has been in the works for years. Its goal has always been to bring multiplayer to the streets of Night City and give players complete freedom over what that looks like. Offering the ability to create one's own server, CyberMP gives hosts control over almost every element of their version of Night City, including NPCs, world events, rules, economy, and more. It's impressive and has the potential to lead to complete reinventions of the core gameplay loop of Cyberpunk 2077 , much in the same way GTA Online does for GTA V .

CyberMP currently allows players to engage in PvP warfare, street races, and roleplaying, all of which are synchronized perfectly across each user's copy of the game. So, cars, unique player outfits, and every action will be seen simultaneously. This is made possible through fast network code as well as Easy Anti-Cheat, which prevents malicious actors from disrupting the server and ruining everyone's experience.

There are plans to add additional features and functions to CyberMP over the coming months, including proximity chat, which would allow for a greater degree of roleplaying potential. Currently, you can download the client from the mod's official website to join existing servers or host your own. It is in its Beta form, so prospective players should expect a myriad of bugs and missing features. However, for the most part, this is the intended CyberMP experience, offering a suite of impressive multiplayer features within Cyberpunk 2077 for the very first time.

It is worth noting that CyberMP is only available for the PC version of Cyberpunk 2077 .

Additionally, CyberMP has been designed with modders in mind, ensuring that the project can be expanded upon by anyone, thus making the possibilities for new features ostensibly endless. It's an exciting addition to the pantheon of amazing Cyberpunk 2077 mods , and a must-have for anyone who's been eagerly anticipating the day that the game finally gets its long-overdue multiplayer offering. Considering just how expansive Cyberpunk 2077's roleplaying options were before CyberMP's launch, fans are undoubtedly in for a world of new and exciting possibilities.

items.content:
Thought you were done with Night City? Well, Night City's not quite done with you!

Patch notes for Cyberpunk 2077's Edgerunners 2 Update (2.5) are now available for your early perusal before the update hits the streets on October 22nd. Watch the Features Overview video to see some of the new features in action:

And if you want to know even more, read through the list of most important changes below:

Edgerunners Content

  • Added a new side quest, Clampdown, set before the events of Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2. To unlock it, complete The Heist and two gigs for Wakako, then wait for a message from her.

    [/*]

  • Added a new 5-piece gear set based on the character King, which can be obtained during the Clampdown side quest.

    [/*]

  • Added a new radio station, HKGN 102.0 FM, featuring a selection of tracks from the Cyberpunk: Edgerunners series.

    [/*]

Show Off

  • A brand-new clothing collection has arrived in Night City! 5 new outfit sets can now be purchased from certain clothing vendors:

    • Maxiwear: available in Heywood, Arroyo, Little China

      [/*]

    • Jinguji: available in City Center

      [/*]

    • NetWatch: available in Kabuki, Japantown

      [/*]

    • IconAmerica: available in Pacifica, Badlands, Northside

      [/*]

    • And one more set that will hit Night City shelves just a little later...

      [/*]
    [/*]

  • The NUS Infiltrator clothing set can be now purchased from clothing vendors in Kabuki and Japantown.

    [/*]

  • 4 new TWINTONE skins for Quadra Turbo-R V-Tech are now available via Twitch Drops.

    [/*]

  • Some of the hairstyles that were previously exclusive to NPCs are now available for V. Please note that some hairstyles are available only to feminine or masculine body types.

    [/*]

  • Show off your chrome! You can now customize your hand cyberware. Equip your Mantis Blades, Gorilla Arms, Monowire or Projectile Launch System, and visit one of 5 Glamdocs (marked with a spray paint icon on the map) to give your implants a fresh, new look. Each Glamdoc is located in a unique shop, along with their own intro scene with voiceover and animations, and offers a unique catalog of cyberware skins with customizable colors.

    [/*]

  • Sometimes one gun just isn't enough. The new Double Trouble perk in the Cool tree (along with four auxiliary perks) introduces an entirely new playstyle, allowing you to dual-wield Pistols and Revolvers from the Power category.

    [/*]

  • Added frames from the Cyberpunk Trading Card Game to Photo Mode, allowing you to make your preem shots look like custom cards.

    [/*]

  • Added new poses in Photo Mode to show off your dual-wielding prowess.

    [/*]

Mod the World

Added Cross-Platform Mod Support, powered by mod.io, a first step into cross-platform modding that allows you to easily browse and install a selection of player-created mods directly from the in-game menu. More mods will become available over time. The feature is available on PC, Mac, PlayStation 5, PlayStation 5 Pro and Xbox Series X|S.

Upgrading the World

  • Welcome to Paradise! Added a new side quest that takes you on a journey to uncover a mystery and explore Night City on a guided tour narrated by Richard Night. It unlocks after completing The Heist and reaching level 15 Street Cred.

    [/*]

  • Added 12 new Minor Arcana Tarot Cards to discover across Night City. The Tarot menu now has separate sections for Major and Minor Arcana. The new tarot cards are part of a new side quest, an extension of Fool on the Hill, which activates after scanning any of the new cards. Collect them all to get a special reward.

    [/*]

Quality of Life

  • Saves in the “Load Game” menu are now grouped by separate playthroughs.

    [/*]

  • Added item filters to apartment and vehicle stashes.

    [/*]

  • Modded saves in the "Load Game" menu are now marked with a dedicated icon. Please note that achievements and trophies cannot be earned while playing on console from a modded save file.

items.title: Cyberpunk 2077 Is The Latest Video Game To Get The Movie Treatment
items.summary: Paramount Pictures will develop the film and CD Projekt Red will produce.
items.content:
Paramount Pictures will develop the film and CD Projekt Red will produce.

CD Projekt Red Add Engadget on Google: Preferred Source Google Discover Movie adaptations of video games are currently doing a brisk business, and today brings a new title into the fold. Deadline reports that Paramount Pictures is working on a live-action film set in the world of Cyberpunk 2077 , a narrative-driven RPG from CD Projekt Red. The game developer is attached to produce the movie along with Lorenzo di Bonaventura, whose past producer credits on action movies run the gamut from Red and Shooter to The Meg and several Michael Bay Transformers flicks.

It's unclear whether this is a separate endeavor from the early-stage news of a production deal with Anonymous Content announced back in 2023. Today's report is also very preliminary, with no suggestions of a plot or cast.

CD Projekt Red's Cyberpunk 2077 is already itself an adaptation of a tabletop game, so it's perhaps not a surprise that it would continue to inspire a ripple effect of retellings. The video game world of Night City has already provided fodder for the anime series Cyberpunk: Edgerunners on Netflix, which is about to return for a second season .

To survive in Night City, you need someone to watch your back. On the way to the major leagues, V managed to gather a remarkable crew. You could even say, a crew to remember!

From trusted allies to unforgettable personalities, these are the people who helped shape V’s journey through the City of Dreams. This episode of It’s All About You is dedicated to the legendary crew that stood by V through every high and low.

Thank you for staying with us and expressing your love for Cyberpunk 2077 in the most creative ways possible. Don’t forget to check out our gallery to see more works, and, of course, share your creations with us: http://cdpred.ly/AAY

See you in the next episode!

items.content:
Listen up, Samurai! 🤘🔥

Celebrate five years of Cyberpunk 2077 in this special anniversary episode of It’s All About You, looking back on Night City’s unforgettable stories through the legends and music you met along your journey!

Sure, the city’s full of noise — sirens, synths, gunfire in the distance — but if there’s one song that became its soul, it’s “Never Fade Away.”

We brought together legendary artists from across the city of dreams to reinterpret this iconic track — each in their own voice, their own style, their own rebellion. ❤️‍🔥

Plug in, turn it up, and dive into our latest It’s All About You episode.

Because legends don’t fade.
